meta.title: Ignacia Ayala | Counseling & Support
meta.description: A space to listen, reflect and grow. Professional support in your process of change.

hero.subtitle: A space for listening and professional support, to find clarity and tools whenever you need them.

aboutMe.title: I'm Ignacia Ayala, professional Counselor
aboutMe.subtitle: I accompany you to find clarity and well-being in the moments you need it most.
aboutMe.text: My goal is to offer you a space of support and listening, where you can explore your emotions and find new perspectives.
aboutMe.credentialsFormationValue: Certificate from the Ministry of Education (Buenos Aires). Additional training in Gerontological Counseling (Orientándome, 2025) and Neurocoaching (Holos, 2024). 2 years of professional experience.
aboutMe.credentialsRegistrationValue: She does not currently hold a professional license or belong to a professional association.
aboutMe.credentialsSourceNote: Source: verified professional profile (Psychology Today / Psicología Hoy). There she's listed as "Consultora Psicológica" (Person-Centered Approach); this site uses "Counselor" as its brand term.

specialties.title: Specialties
specialties.sourceNote: From her verified professional profile (Psychology Today / Psicología Hoy).

items.title: Spirituality
items.description: A space to explore the spiritual dimension of well-being, integrated into the therapeutic process.

items.title: Grief
items.description: Support through processes of loss and grief.

items.title: Couples therapy
items.description: Working with couples on connection, communication and conflict.

items.title: Anxiety
items.description: Tools for managing anxiety in everyday life.

items.title: Modality
items.description: In-person sessions at the office (Bulevar José Batlle y Ordóñez 1624, Apt. 603, Montevideo) or online by video call, Monday through Saturday. Sessions are conducted in Spanish.

items.title: The first session
items.description: You can book a free 15-minute introductory call to talk about what brings you to therapy and how she works, before deciding whether to continue.

logistics.title: Fees & logistics
logistics.sourceNote: Fees and payment methods from her verified professional profile — confirm they're still current with Ignacia.

items.title: Fees
items.description: Individual session: $1500 (Uruguayan pesos). Couples therapy: $1700. Sliding scale available based on income — ask directly. Payment by cash, card or transfer, on the day of the session.

items.title: Insurance / health plan
items.description: Does not work with insurance or health plans — payment is out of pocket.

confidentiality.text: Everything shared in session is protected by professional confidentiality, with the legal exceptions that apply when life is at risk.
confidentiality.emergencyLead: This form is not an emergency channel.
confidentiality.emergencyIntro: If you're in crisis or at risk, contact Uruguay's suicide-prevention Life Line:
confidentiality.emergencyClosing: free, 24 hours a day, every day of the year.
